testcase.name: Scenario: Resize a docked panel from its shared boundary: tmp/obk-dock-bdd-4069/features/application/docking-system/docking-system.feature:31:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Resize a docked panel from its shared boundary ✔ Given a part document is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a dockable panel is docked beside the viewport ✔ When the user drags the panel boundary away from the viewport ✔ Then the panel becomes wider ✔ And the viewport becomes narrower by the corresponding amount ✔ And the panel contents and active part remain visible ✔ When the user drags the boundary back ✔ Then the panel and viewport return to their previous proportions
